hook.en: A juicer turns fruit into juice, and a freezer turns juice into ice candy. Joining the two machines gives a new one: fruit in, ice candy out. That is *composition*.
hook.kn: ಜ್ಯೂಸರ್ ಹಣ್ಣನ್ನು ರಸವಾಗಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, ಫ್ರೀಜರ್ ರಸವನ್ನು ಐಸ್ ಕ್ಯಾಂಡಿಯಾಗಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಎರಡನ್ನೂ ಜೋಡಿಸಿದರೆ ಹೊಸ ಯಂತ್ರ: ಹಣ್ಣು ಒಳಗೆ, ಐಸ್ ಕ್ಯಾಂಡಿ ಹೊರಗೆ. ಇದೇ ಸಂಯೋಜನೆ.

title.en: See that composition is not commutative
Use composition with modulus and rational functions

say.en: A juicer turns fruit into juice, and a freezer turns juice into ice candy. Joining the two machines gives a new one: fruit in, ice candy out. That is composition. In this lesson: Form g∘f and f∘g.
See that composition is not commutative.
Use composition with modulus and rational functions.

body.en: If $f : A \to B$ and $g : B \to C$, the *composition* $g \circ f : A \to C$ is defined by $(g \circ f)(x) = g(f(x))$. Apply $f$ first, then $g$. In general $g \circ f \ne f \circ g$, but composition is associative.
body.kn: f : A → B, g : B → C ಆದರೆ (g∘f)(x) = g(f(x)). ಮೊದಲು f, ನಂತರ g. ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯವಾಗಿ g∘f ≠ f∘g.

points.en: Read g∘f right to left: f first
If f and g are one-one (onto), so is g∘f

narration.en: g of f means: apply f first, then g. Usually g of f and f of g are different functions, but composition is associative.
narration.kn: f : A → B, g : B → C ಆದರೆ (g∘f)(x) = g(f(x)). ಮೊದಲು f, ನಂತರ g. ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯವಾಗಿ g∘f ≠ f∘g.

say.en: g of f means: apply f first, then g. Usually g of f and f of g are different functions, but composition is associative. Read g∘f right to left: f first.
say.kn: f: A gives B, g: B gives C ಆದರೆ (g∘f)x equals g(fx). ಮೊದಲು f, ನಂತರ g. ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯವಾಗಿ g∘f is not equal to f∘g.

say.en: g∘f is not equal to f∘g in general.
h∘(g∘f) equals (h∘g)∘f.
If f and g are one-one onto, so is g∘f.

title.en: A composition is two machines in a row

say.en: Think of f and g as machines. The output of f goes straight into g. So g of f means: do f first, then g.
Take f of x equals x plus 1 and g of x equals x squared. Put in 2.
g of f of 2: f gives 3, then g gives 9. But f of g of 2: g gives 4, then f gives 5. The order matters.
In general g of f of x is x plus 1 the whole squared, while f of g of x is x squared plus 1. Composition is still associative.

problem.en: f(x) = x², g(x) = 2x + 1. Find g∘f and f∘g, and compare them at x = 1.

steps.en: At x = 1: g∘f gives 3, f∘g gives 9.

narration.en: Let us solve this together. f(x) = x², g(x) = 2x + 1. Find g∘f and f∘g, and compare them at x = 1.

say.en: Let us solve this together. fx equals x squared, gx equals 2x plus 1. Find g∘f and f∘g, and compare them at x equals 1.
(g∘f)x equals gx squared equals 2x squared plus 1.
(f∘g)x equals f2x plus 1 equals 2x plus 1 squared.
At x equals 1: g∘f gives 3, f∘g gives 9.
So the answer is g∘f is not equal to f∘g.

problem.en: f(x) = 8x³ and g(x) = x^(1/3). Find g∘f and f∘g.

narration.en: Let us solve this together. f(x) = 8x³ and g(x) = x^(1/3). Find g∘f and f∘g.

say.en: Let us solve this together. fx equals 8x cubed and gx equals x^(1 over 3). Find g∘f and f∘g.
(g∘f)x equals 8x cubed^(1 over 3) equals 2x.
(f∘g)x equals 8(x^(1 over 3)) cubed equals 8x.
So the answer is g∘fx equals 2x, f∘gx equals 8x.
